title: feat(ftwoseed): f_two first wave exists from a 2-site face-diagonal seed
science: Bounded_theorem note, no probe cell. COMPLETE SEED CLASSIFICATION for the rival member f_two, an if-and-only-if result: (1) EVERY one-site seed has an empty first wave, on all twelve vertices, since no site has two neighbours equal to a single lock so u<=1; (2) a two-site seed has a nonempty first wave IFF the two sites are opposite corners of an on-patch square (a face diagonal), and there are exactly 22 such pairs out of C(12,2)=66 -- counted as 6 faces on A + 6 on B, two diagonals each, minus 2 for the shared face double-count -- with the other 44 empty; (3) an explicit 3-site seed also works. Hence the MINIMAL seed cardinality for a nonempty f_two first wave is 2, not 3. Sharp mechanism: a site adjacent to both locks along the SAME axis has that axis balanced (1=1) and so u=0, the anti-monotone cancellation of #6301 reappearing. The note also records 'every two-site seed has empty first wave' explicitly as a FAILED MUTATION rather than a theorem. 30/30 runner PASS.
